topics.name: range per charge
topics.description: Real-world distance on one charge versus claimed range, effects of hills, cold, eco mode or rider weight, battery ageing, and range-display accuracy.

topics.name: motor and assist behavior
topics.description: How the motor and pedal assist deliver power: smoothness, jerky pickup, hill strength, noise, torque sensing, assist levels and the speed cutoff.

topics.name: folding mechanism and fold size
topics.description: Ease and speed of folding, latch and hinge quality, folded dimensions and stability, and the fold process with accessories attached.

topics.name: ride comfort and fit
topics.description: Comfort and ergonomics: saddle, suspension, tyres, vibration on rough roads, handlebar and seat dimensions, and fit for different rider heights.

topics.name: charging and battery handling
topics.description: Charging time, charger design, removable battery, charging port and connector, and practical battery handling.

topics.name: price and value
topics.description: Whether the cost is justified, comparisons with other bikes, discounts, resale value and accessory pricing.

topics.name: brakes and stopping
topics.description: Braking performance and issues: fade, squeal, spongy feel, wet-weather stopping, lever reach and pad questions.
